# EvidaPath

> Free help for international secondary-school students choosing, affording and applying to universities abroad: tuition, living costs, entry requirements and deadlines, taken from universities' own published pages. Where a figure isn't published, EvidaPath says so instead of guessing.

As of 24 November 2026, EvidaPath lists 53 universities in 8 countries (Australia, Canada, Germany, Malaysia, the Netherlands, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom and the United States) and 459 programmes. Figures link to the official page they were read from. Some yearly fees are worked out from a per-credit rate or a whole-course total; the site says so where it does. Universities change fees and rules, so confirm with the university before applying or paying.

## Main pages
- [Questions answered](https://evidapath.com/answers): tuition for international students by country, the cheapest universities in Dubai on EvidaPath, IB, IELTS and SAT requirements, and UAE scholarships, each with its source.
- [Universities](https://evidapath.com/universities): tuition, living costs, entry requirements by qualification, English tests and application deadlines for each programme.
- [Find My Path](https://evidapath.com/find-my-path): answer 4 questions (curriculum, grades, subject, yearly budget) and see programmes that fit. No sign-in needed.
- [Scholarships](https://evidapath.com/scholarships): scholarships at universities on EvidaPath. The page marks itself as a preview while scholarship records are still being checked.
- University pages (https://evidapath.com/universities/<name>, e.g. https://evidapath.com/universities/university-of-toronto): every programme's fees, entry requirements by qualification and deadlines for one university. All of them are listed in https://evidapath.com/sitemap.xml.
- Country cost pages (https://evidapath.com/study-in/<country>/cost, e.g. https://evidapath.com/study-in/united-kingdom/cost): each university's lowest yearly tuition for international students in that country, with sources.
- [Careers by degree](https://evidapath.com/careers): jobs each degree can lead to, with UK pay ranges from the UK government's National Careers Service.

## What students can do (details: https://evidapath.com/features)
- No account needed: entry requirements by qualification (IB Diploma; A-Levels: GCE, Edexcel, Cambridge; US High School Diploma + APs; UAE Ministry of Education; Indian CBSE / ISC; German Abitur; other national curricula), the full yearly and whole-degree cost (tuition, compulsory fees, living costs, minus guaranteed scholarships), scholarship eligibility by citizenship, visa costs and post-study work rules (UK, Canada, Germany, Netherlands; official links for the US, Australia, Malaysia and the UAE), careers with UK pay, and Find My Path matching across countries.
- With a free account: a fit check for one university with an optional AI explanation, a dated application and scholarship plan, a family funding-gap plan comparing two universities, application and document tracking, the Offer Vault for offer letters, and offer comparison.
